title: mauranthemum reboudianum
intro: Mauranthemum reboudianum, commonly known as the Creeping Thistle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to support digestive health. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Mauranthemum reboudianum include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
